Choose Your Breed

Ragdoll or Maine Coon: which one is right for your home?

Not sure? Tell us your household when you request pricing above and we'll help you decide.

Ragdoll Kittens

Gentle, affectionate, and famously relaxed, Ragdolls are known for going limp when picked up and following their people from room to room.

  • Colors: Color Point (seal, blue, chocolate, lilac, red), Bicolor, Lynx
  • Rare colors: Sepia, Lilac, Cinnamon, Solids
  • Large, semi-longhair breed with a soft, plush coat

Maine Coon Kittens

One of the largest domestic breeds, playful, dog-like in loyalty, and known for tufted ears and an easygoing personality that fits busy households.

  • Large, sturdy build with a longer, water-resistant coat
  • Highly social, good with children and other pets
  • Known for a chirpy, "chatty" vocal style

Questions

Frequently asked questions

Why are Ragdolls and Maine Coons priced higher than a shelter cat?

Pricing reflects genetic health testing on breeding cats (40+ diseases), TICA registration, veterinary care, high-quality nutrition, and the months of hands-on raising each litter receives before going home.

Is a Ragdoll or Maine Coon the right fit for my home?

Both breeds are gentle and social. Ragdolls tend to be calmer and more lap-oriented; Maine Coons are larger and more playful/vocal. Tell us about your household in the form above and we'll help you decide.

What does the reservation process look like?

Request pricing, then place a 50% non-refundable deposit to reserve a specific kitten or a spot in an upcoming litter. You'll receive updates and photos until your kitten is ready at 10–12 weeks, vaccinated and vet-checked.

Is the deposit refundable?

The deposit is non-refundable, as it reserves a kitten exclusively for you and takes that kitten off the availability list. The remaining balance is due at pickup.

What health guarantees come with each kitten?

Every kitten is tested for hereditary diseases, comes with a yearly genetic health guarantee, and is vaccinated and dewormed prior to adoption, with records provided.
